title: Political Science - Global Politics Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Humanities [HUM]

POL S 101 [SSCI]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Diversity [DIVR]

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

POL S 102

Electives

Arts [ARTS]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

POL S 103

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

Minor Field Elective

POL S 201

POL S Elective
POL S Electives may need to include [M] courses to fulfill University requirements.

Complete Writing Portfolio

300-400-level POL S Electives
POL S Electives may need to include [M] courses to fulfill University requirements.

Minor Field Elective or Foreign Language, if applicable

POL S Global Courses
POL S Global Courses: Choose from POL S 305, 314, 405 [M], 418, 424 [M], 428, 429, 432 [M], 435, 447 [M], 472 [M], 474, 475, or 476 [M].

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

Minor Field Elective, if applicable, or Elective

POL S 427

300-400-level Electives

International Experience
International Experience: Students may satisfy the International Experience requirement by completing a minor in Foreign Language or Global Studies, or by earning at least 3 credit hours while completing one of the following: a) Study abroad (at a WSU-approved program); b) International internship (POL S 497 approved by POL S advisor; either abroad or in U.S.-based internship that includes global activities); or c) Military Science (MIL SCI 402 while enrolled in ROTC).

300-400-level Electives, including Minor Field, if applicable

Complete the School’s Exit Survey for Political Science majors

A student may be admitted to the Political Science - Global Politics option upon making their intention known to the department.

36 credits in POL S are required, at least 15 of which must be earned at WSU. Consult advisor on International Experience requirement.
